confirmation.summary: Positive newborn screen; compound heterozygous BCKDHA missense variant and a paracentric chr19 inversion found by whole-genome sequencing.
evidence: She tested positive for MSUD in a newborn screening (NBS) performed at 5 days of age
a paracentric inversion disrupting Intron 1 of BCKDHA, which was identified by whole‐genome sequencing

note.text: Soon after my daughter was born, doctors said her blood sugar was very low. A newborn blood test showed unusually high amounts of certain substances, and she needed hospital treatment during her first week. Doctors also said her blood had become too acidic. Later, whenever she caught an infection, she sometimes became barely responsive and needed care in an intensive care unit. By age ten, learning and understanding things were much harder for her than for other children her age.
note.author: T33 hand-off (assistant-written from the article; not the parent's words)

phenotypes.label: Hypoglycemia
phenotypes.evidence: At birth, she was found to have mild hypoglycemia and was temporarily administered a glucose infusion

phenotypes.label: Metabolic acidosis

phenotypes.label: Hyperleucinemia

phenotypes.label: Hypervalinemia
phenotypes.comment: As above; not named in the note.

phenotypes.label: Reduced consciousness
phenotypes.evidence: admitted to the intensive care unit three times because of severe metabolic acidosis with impaired consciousness

phenotypes.label: Moderate intellectual disability
phenotypes.notePhrase: learning and understanding things were much harder for her
phenotypes.comment: An IQ of 44 falls in the moderate range; the note itself does not convey the severity.

uncertainty: Severity (moderate) is inferred from the reported IQ score, not stated in words by the authors.
